I don’t have real‑time access to your system clock, but you can easily check the current time on a Windows machine with the built‑in `time` command:

```cmd
C:\> time /t
```

This will display something like:

```
10:45 AM
```

If you’re running a script and need the current time programmatically, you can use PowerShell:

```powershell
Get-Date
```

or in Python:

```python
import datetime
print(datetime.datetime.now())
```
